scope: Two additions to owner furniture inventory; official catalog product photos only, not a stock or purchasing check.

items.evidence: User-linked prod24520382 currently shows Natural Performance Linen Weave / Burnished Brass. A focused official RH search found prod7440412 of the same Emery Track Arm Fabric Dining Armchair; its og:image and alternateImages explicitly caption White Italian Textured Weave / Polished Stainless Steel. That actual returned photo was downloaded HTTP200 image/jpeg and visually inspected: upholstered straight track arms, back/seat and silver rectangular sled frame. No armless side-chair image used.
